description:
Prepare a handout for the 'Workplace Safety Orientation' presentation. 

1. Open the 'Handout Master' view (View > Master Handout).
2. Add the text "INTERNAL TRAINING MATERIAL" to the Header area.
3. Export the presentation as a PDF to '/home/ga/Documents/results/safety_handouts.pdf' with the following settings:
   - Export 'Handouts' (not Slides)
   - Layout: 3 slides per page
